title: Block Target Info
description: A tiny always-on HUD that reads the block under your crosshair: name, hardness, the right tool, and the light level.
body:
### Block Target Info

A small, always-on HUD overlay that tells you what you're looking at. Aim at any solid block and a tidy 4-line readout appears in the corner:

- **Block name** — the same name F3 would show, in clean English (e.g. "Oak Log", "Diamond Ore", "Obsidian").
- **Hardness** — how long it takes to mine, colour-coded so you can tell a 0.5-hardness shrub from a 50-hardness obsidian block at a glance.
- **Tool** — pickaxe / axe / shovel / hoe / hand, so you don't have to remember which tool drops what.
- **Light level** — the light on the face you're aiming at, with separate block-light and sky-light readouts (B / S). Goes amber under 8, red at 0, so you can spot spawnable surfaces while you build.

Pure client-side, drop-in, works on any server. No mixins, no gameplay changes.

### Why?

F3 is huge and ugly and floods your screen with debug info. Other HUD mods focus on coordinates or biomes. This one does **one** thing: tells you about the block you're pointing at. Useful while building, mining, or just learning the game.

### Controls & config

- Default toggle key: **B**. Press at any time to show/hide the readout.
- Config file: `<minecraft>/config/blocktarget.json`. Choose the corner, which lines to show, the toggle key, and the max distance.

### Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.8 – 1.21.10 (single JAR).
- **Loader:** Fabric.
- **Side:** client-only — no need to install on the server.

### Credits

Original mod, MIT licence. Issues / PRs welcome.
